gri_path: GRI 1: Chapter 80 tin; powder of tin alloy not in 8003 (bars, rods, wire)

rejected_alternatives.reason: Covers bars, rods, profiles and wire, not powder

missing_facts: Weight percentages of tin, silver, copper
classification.rationale: A tin-dominant alloy powder of Ag and Cu is an article of tin alloy. Not wire or bars, so it falls in the residual heading 8007 as other articles of tin.
